_comment: This is manga-image-translator's own config format, passed through with
--config-file. Every field below is upstream's; only the defaults we
changed are explained. Copy to config/mit-config.json and edit freely.
The translator block is overwritten at run time from config.yaml
(translator / target_lang / gpt_config), so do not bother editing it here.
Tune detection, OCR, inpainting and rendering here -- that is the whole
point of keeping this file separate from config.yaml.

ocr._ignore_bubble_hint: Threshold for ignoring text outside bubbles. Keep 0 for comics where dialogue and sound effects are drawn directly on the art; raising it silently deletes that text.

inpainter._inpainting_precision_hint: fp32. Half precision makes torch.fft raise on non power-of-two feature maps, and is slower even when it works.

render._disable_font_border_hint: false keeps the outline. Most comics have outlined text on top of art; the outline is what keeps the replacement readable over imperfect inpainting.
render._no_hyphenation_hint: true stops the renderer splitting words, which matters when proper nouns are kept in the source language.
